/.title: Vallix Labs | Tabular foundation models built for your data
/.description: Vallix Labs builds task-specific, scale-adaptive tabular foundation models. Valli builds a model for your problem from your table; Tvarit serves tabular foundation models with fast inference.

/research.title: Research & Benchmarks | Vallix Labs
/research.description: Valli benchmarked against released tabular models on synthetic tables, TabArena and real scientific datasets: leaderboards, accuracy and calibration at 25 to 1,000 labelled rows.

/playground.title: Playground | Vallix Labs
/playground.description: Type a few labelled rows and watch a small in-browser demo model predict the rest of the table.
